item.title: Ballymena mourns loss of respected former Mayor PJ McAvoy
item.description: Tributes have been paid following the passing of former Ballymena Mayor and long-serving councillor PJ McAvoy, a respected public figure who dedicated three decades to serving the people of the town. Mr McAvoy, who sadly passed away on Thursday 19 February, was widely recognised for his commitment to public life and his efforts to foster cooperation and mutual respect within local government. item.description: The site for a proposed boat shed at Bay Road, Carnlough on the Antrim coast. item.description: Police are dealing with a stabbing incident in Lurgan this evening, with a man taken to hospital and a woman in her 20s arrested.
